:::{#def-range}
#### Range

The word **range** of a [function](#def-function) $f : A \to B$ has two conflicting meanings,
and sources use one or the other:

- the [image](#def-image) of $f$, the set $f(A)$ of values that $f$ actually takes;
- the [codomain](#def-codomain) of $f$, the set $B$ that its values are required to lie in.

To avoid the ambiguity, these notes write "image" or "codomain" instead,
and recommend that you do too
[@wikipedia_range_of_a_function].

:::
